# 10 - Tools

Counted from the registries that define it. Run `pnpm census` after changing
a tool, a skill, a prompt, a role, a command or a guardrail;
`tests/docs/census-generated.test.mjs` compares this file against the live
registry, so a stale copy fails the build instead of misleading a reader.

## Action tools (102)

The tools that do something rather than serve a skill. Every one is
deterministic: none of them calls a model, so the same arguments return the
same result behind any client.

### rule_tool

Route prompt to correct rule-mcp skill. Returns structured routing with relevant sections.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Default | Description                                                                 |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`    | string | yes      | -       | User's question about frontend development                                  |
| `framework` | string | no       | -       | Optional framework hint (react, vue, svelte, angular, etc.) to bias routing |
| `path`      | string | no       | -       | Optional project path for auto-detecting framework                          |

### rule_tool_meta

Route meta-framework request to right rule-mcp skill: Astro, Next.js, Nuxt or Remix. Returns skill, its relevant sections and base framework skill to load with it.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Default | Description                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`    | string | yes      | -       | What to build or change in a meta-framework: rendering, routing, data loading, deployment |
| `framework` | string | no       | -       | Optional framework hint (astro, next, nuxt, remix) to skip the concept match              |

### rule_tool_search

Semantic search across ALL rule-mcp skills using BM25 ranking. Returns scored, relevant sections.

| Parameter    | Type    | Required | Default | Description                                     |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `query`      | string  | yes      | -       | Search query to find across all rule-mcp skills |
| `maxResults` | integer | no       | `10`    | Maximum number of ranked results                |

### rule_tool_check

Run guardrail checks on code against any rule-mcp skill. Returns guardrail results with re-check hint containing current passing set. Run until allPass: true.

| Parameter             | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                          |
| --------------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `skill`               | string          | yes      | -       | Target rule-mcp skill name                                                                                                           |
| `code`                | string          | no       | -       | Code to validate against guardrails (omit with mode=project)                                                                         |
| `framework`           | string          | no       | -       | Framework (react, vue, svelte, angular, solid, astro, vanilla)                                                                       |
| `fileName`            | string          | no       | -       | File name for naming convention checks                                                                                               |
| `isComponent`         | boolean         | no       | -       | Whether this is a component file                                                                                                     |
| `mode`                | string          | no       | -       | Check mode: 'scaffold' for project config files, 'project' for the graph guardrails, 'semantic' for the advisory decision-model rule |
| `allowedDependencies` | array of string | no       | -       | Manifest-derived package names allowed in imports                                                                                    |
| `projectDir`          | string          | no       | -       | Project root for mode=project (default: cwd)                                                                                         |
| `diagnostics`         | boolean         | no       | -       | Run the optional type-checker check in mode=project                                                                                  |

### rule_tool_detect

Detect project framework, TypeScript usage, and build tool from package.json.

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Default | Description            |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | ---------------------- |
| `path`    | string | no       | `"."`   | Project directory path |

### rule_tool_compress

Sole compression engine (ADR 115): preprocess enriched prompts/contexts and postprocess model prose. Strip filler and leading articles, replace typographic characters with ASCII, convert British spelling to American. Code, inline spans, URLs and JSON are never touched. Prefer /rule-compress.

| Parameter  | Type                                     | Required | Default  | Description                                                                                                                       |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text`     | string                                   | yes      | -        | Prose to compress. Code fences, inline code, URLs and JSON pass through untouched                                                 |
| `mode`     | `both` \| `compression` \| `fingerprint` | no       | `"both"` | both (default), compression (filler only), fingerprint (punctuation and spelling only)                                            |
| `fileName` | string                                   | no       | -        | Where the prose came from, when it came from a file. A sensitive name (.env, credentials, id_rsa, anything under .ssh) is refused |

### rule_tool_fix

Apply deterministic guardrail fixes of every skill (blank lines, braces, ASCII typography, American spelling) to changed files or explicit list.

| Parameter | Type            | Required | Default  | Description                                                                                           |
| --------- | --------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `files`   | array of string | no       | -        | Files to fix, relative to the project root. Default: the changed files (working tree plus untracked). |
| `path`    | string          | no       | `"."`    | Only files under this prefix are touched (default: the whole project)                                 |
| `mode`    | `lint` \| `fix` | no       | `"lint"` | lint: report what a fix would change. fix: write the deterministic fixes.                             |
| `dryRun`  | boolean         | no       | -        | Preview even in fix mode                                                                              |

### rule_tool_structural

Declare current task structural or architectural. next write asks for one confirmation, stating this summary, and rest of task proceeds without asking again. Call it before changing boundary, contract, dependency or layout, not for ordinary edits.

| Parameter    | Type   | Required | Default | Description                                                                                |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `summary`    | string | yes      | -       | What is changing and why it is structural, in one sentence the person confirming can judge |
| `projectDir` | string | no       | -       | Project root directory                                                                     |

### rule_tool_git

Audit the feature history and normalize it: base branch, merge base, commit range, Conventional Commit violations and merge commits. `reword` applies proposed messages; `linearize` removes merge commits; `squash` closes the feature as one commit and folds the feature's own ADRs and handoffs into one document each (deterministic concatenation, originals deleted, indexes rebuilt). The destructive actions need force:true to be proposed and confirm:true to run. Every rewrite verifies what changed and rolls back on an unexpected path.

| Parameter    | Type                                           | Required | Default   | Description                                          |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectDir` | string                                         | no       | `"."`     | Project root (default: cwd)                          |
| `action`     | `audit` \| `reword` \| `linearize` \| `squash` | no       | `"audit"` | audit, reword, linearize, or squash                  |
| `force`      | boolean                                        | no       | `false`   | Enable a history-normalization proposal (--force)    |
| `confirm`    | boolean                                        | no       | `false`   | Required to run a rewrite; the confirmation gate     |
| `baseBranch` | string                                         | no       | -         | Override the detected base branch                    |
| `message`    | string                                         | no       | -         | For squash: the final type(scope): summary           |
| `rewrites`   | array of object                                | no       | -         | For reword: the message proposed for each commit sha |

### rule_tool_init

Prepare project for rule-mcp: create central recorder directory under state dir, install or integrate git governance (commit-msg gate and pre-push gate that enforce type(scope): subject, installing Husky only when Node project has no hook mechanism), migrate leftover local.rule-mcp if present, and run tokensave init when installed. Recorder state is never written into repository. Pass noTokensave: true to skip tokensave.

| Parameter     | Type    | Required | Default | Description                 |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------- |
| `projectDir`  | string  | no       | -       | Project root (default: cwd) |
| `noTokensave` | boolean | no       | `false` | Skip tokensave init         |

### rule_tool_plan

Ask expert review persona to audit, review or plan this project; returns operation contract.

| Parameter    | Type                          | Required | Default | Description                                                                          |
| ------------ | ----------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `role`       | string                        | yes      | -       | Role id (security, privacy, a11y...)                                                 |
| `years`      | integer                       | no       | -       |                                                                                      |
| `skills`     | array of string               | no       | -       |                                                                                      |
| `topic`      | string                        | no       | -       | Free-text request; becomes the binding scope of the run. Default: the whole project. |
| `projectDir` | string                        | no       | -       |                                                                                      |
| `operation`  | `plan` \| `audit` \| `review` | no       | -       | Which document this run produces: plan, audit, or review (default: all three)        |

| `skills`     | array of string | no       | -       |                                                                                      |
| `topic`      | string          | no       | -       | Free-text request; becomes the binding scope of the run. Default: the whole project. |
| `projectDir` | string          | no       | -       |                                                                                      |

| Parameter    | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                          |

| `role`       | string          | yes      | -       | Role id (security, privacy, a11y...)                                                 |

| `skills`     | array of string | no       | -       |                                                                                      |
| `topic`      | string          | no       | -       | Free-text request; becomes the binding scope of the run. Default: the whole project. |

### rule_tool_impersonation

Create or refresh audit/review/plan documents for review persona run (impersonation bookkeeping).

| Parameter    | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                 |
| ------------ | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `role`       | string          | yes      | -       | Role id                                                                                     |
| `findings`   | array of object | no       | -       | What this run found. Anything omitted counts as closed - unless a scope is set.             |
| `scope`      | string          | no       | -       | The binding scope of a scoped run: findings outside it stay untouched instead of resolving. |
| `projectDir` | string          | no       | -       |                                                                                             |

### rule_tool_stats

Read the local telemetry log and summarize it: call counts, cache hit rate, saved/estimated tokens, latency.

| Parameter | Type                         | Required | Default  | Description            |
| --------- | ---------------------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `scope`   | `session` \| `week` \| `all` | no       | `"week"` | session\\              | week\\ | all |
| `flight`  | string                       | no       | -        | Path to a .flight file |

### rule_tool_sync

Check how far base branch has moved since this branch forked, and propose rebase. Read-only by default; `action: rebase` needs `confirm: true` and refuses on dirty tree. conflict is reported with its files and never resolved automatically.

| Parameter    | Type                | Required | Default   | Description                                                          |
| ------------ | ------------------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectDir` | string              | no       | `"."`     | Project root (default: cwd)                                          |
| `action`     | `check` \| `rebase` | no       | `"check"` | check (read-only) or rebase (needs confirm)                          |
| `confirm`    | boolean             | no       | `false`   | Required for action=rebase; the confirmation gate                    |
| `baseBranch` | string              | no       | -         | Override the detected base branch                                    |
| `fetch`      | boolean             | no       | `false`   | Fetch the base remote first, so the check sees the remote's position |

### rule_tool_update

Force-update this local MCP server to newest release tag (checkout main, pull, reinstall), or fast-forward upstream branch when no tags exist yet. Also runs automatically (throttled, in background) on tool calls; call directly to update on demand.

Takes no parameters.

### rule_tool_handon

Read last handoff in docs/handoff/ and report which of its claims are still true: branch, commit range, files, ADRs, open work. Sweeps completed audits/reviews/plans into ADRs first, then proposes next workstream each open plan still carries, for user to confirm. Never re-runs claimed command.

| Parameter    | Type    | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                          |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectDir` | string  | no       | `"."`   | Project root directory                                                                                               |
| `file`       | string  | no       | -       | A specific handoff to read instead of the newest                                                                     |
| `list`       | boolean | no       | `false` | List the handoffs and verify nothing                                                                                 |
| `closeout`   | boolean | no       | `true`  | Archive completed audits/reviews/plans into ADRs before verifying (default on; false = verify only, nothing written) |

### rule_tool_process_adr

Save Architecture Decision Record (ADR) to docs/adr/. Auto-numbers, maintains index, uses Nygard template.

| Parameter      | Type                                                     | Required | Default            | Description                                                           |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`        | string                                                   | yes      | -                  | ADR title, in English (e.g. 'Use PostgreSQL as the primary database') |
| `status`       | `proposed` \| `accepted` \| `deprecated` \| `superseded` | no       | `"accepted"`       | ADR status                                                            |
| `context`      | string                                                   | no       | -                  | Context: what forcing factors led to this decision                    |
| `decision`     | string                                                   | no       | -                  | The decision made and why                                             |
| `consequences` | string                                                   | no       | -                  | Consequences: positive and negative outcomes                          |
| `alternatives` | array of string                                          | no       | -                  | Alternative options considered                                        |
| `tags`         | array of string                                          | no       | `["architecture"]` | Tags for categorization (e.g. database, api, frontend)                |
| `projectDir`   | string                                                   | no       | `"."`              | Project root directory                                                |

### rule_tool_handoff

Generate compressed LLM handoff summary from ADR logs and project context. Archives completed audits/reviews/plans as ADRs and repairs ADR numbering first (pass closeout: false to diagnose without writing). Paste output into new chat to resume work seamlessly.

| Parameter         | Type                           | Required | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------ | -------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projectDir`      | string                         | no       | `"."`       | Project root directory                                                                                                                         |
| `mode`            | `handoff` \| `close-session`   | no       | `"handoff"` | handoff: generate context summary. close-session: the same, with the session-close banner.                                                     |
| `closeout`        | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Archive completed audits/reviews/plans into ADRs and repair the ADR numbering first (default on; false = read-only diagnosis, nothing written) |
| `includeContext`  | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Include .context/ values                                                                                                                       |
| `includeAdrs`     | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Include ADR summaries                                                                                                                          |
| `includeIdentity` | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Include project identity                                                                                                                       |
| `includeGitDiff`  | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Include git working tree diff                                                                                                                  |
| `includeGitLog`   | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Include recent git log                                                                                                                         |
| `includeRoadmap`  | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Include roadmap/docs scan                                                                                                                      |
| `compress`        | boolean                        | no       | `true`      | Aggressively compress output (default: on)                                                                                                     |
| `maxTokens`       | number                         | no       | `0`         | Target max tokens (0 = no limit)                                                                                                               |
| `format`          | `full` \| `brief` \| `minimal` | no       | `"full"`    | Output detail level                                                                                                                            |

### rule_tool_gateway

Single-entry orchestrator: routes prompt -> loads skill evidence -> checks code against guardrails -> returns receipt. Use this as primary entry point instead of calling rule-mcp + skill tools separately. returned receipt must be passed to rule_tool_apply when writing files.

| Parameter   | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                           |
| ----------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`    | string          | yes      | -       | Complete coding request                                                                               |
| `code`      | string          | no       | -       | Code to validate against guardrails (single file)                                                     |
| `files`     | array of object | no       | -       | Files to validate - yields a path-bound receipt, required for multi-file writes                       |
| `path`      | string          | no       | -       | Project path for framework auto-detection                                                             |
| `framework` | string          | no       | -       | Target framework (react, vue, svelte, angular, solid, astro, vanilla, express, fastify, nestjs, hono) |

### rule_tool_apply

Write files to disk after rule_tool_gateway validation. Needs valid receipt from rule_tool_gateway proving that code passed all guardrails. receipt is tied to exact code hash - modified code will be rejected. Use dryRun=true (default) to preview without writing.

| Parameter | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                         |
| --------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `files`   | array of object | yes      | -       | Array of files to create/write                                      |
| `receipt` | string          | yes      | -       | Receipt token from rule_tool_gateway that validated this exact code |
| `path`    | string          | no       | `"."`   | Project root directory                                              |
| `dryRun`  | boolean         | no       | `true`  | Preview without writing (default: true)                             |

## Skill tools (0)

One per catalog skill, generated from the directory. Each serves its
`SKILL.md` and the sections a route selected, and every one takes the same
arguments, so they are listed by area rather than one heading at a time.
The catalog itself, with what each skill covers, is
[`09-skills.md`](09-skills.md).

| Area | Tools |
| ---- | ----- |

### Arguments, the same for all 0

Takes no parameters.
